spec.scene: A thick dark blue padded gym mat covers the floor. At the back edge rises an angled light gray climbing wall that overhangs steeply forward. Across the wall, a bold route of chunky purple resin holds climbs diagonally upward. In the center, clinging to the overhanging wall, a small climber in an orange tank top reaches triumphant toward the top hold. Below on the mat, a small figure in navy looks up with cheering arms. To the right rests a teal chalk bag beside a dusting of white powder.
spec.title: Purple V4 on the Overhang
spec.caption: I finally sent the purple V4 on the overhang, first try.
